shellCommands.command: cat package.json && echo "---" && find . -maxdepth 3 -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' | sort
find /workspace/app/product -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | sort
cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -100
cat -A package.json | head -1; git diff package.json; git status

node -e "console.log(Object.keys(require('react')))" 2>&1 | tr ',' '\n' | grep -i transition
echo "---next version---"
cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
echo "---search next dist for ViewTransition---"
grep -rl "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server 2>/dev/null | head -20
grep -rl "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "---react version---"
cat node_modules/react/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -n -i "transition" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts
echo "---"
grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "--- config schema ---"
grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js 2>/dev/null
find node_modules/next/dist -iname "*config-shared*"

grep -n "viewTransition\|ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts
echo "---"
grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.map$"

grep -n "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js node_modules/react/cjs/react.production.js 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo "---check react package.json for canary tag---"
cat node_modules/react/package.json | grep -A2 '"version"'
echo "---check if next has a postinstall or script that swaps react---"
grep -n "postinstall\|scripts" -A5 node_modules/next/package.json | head -30
echo "--- check upgrading doc for react requirement ---"
sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md 2>/dev/null | grep -n -i "react"
grep -n -i "view.transition\|canary\|19\." node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md | head -40
grep -n -A10 '"peerDependencies"' node_modules/next/package.json
timeout 15 npm view react@canary version 2>&1 | tail -20

timeout 15 npm view react-dom@canary version 2>&1
echo "---types---"
timeout 15 npm view @types/react versions --json 2>&1 | tail -5
timeout 15 npm view @types/react-dom versions --json 2>&1 | tail -5
npm install react@canary react-dom@canary --save-exact 2>&1 | tail -30

grep -n '"version"' node_modules/react/package.json node_modules/react-dom/package.json
node -e "console.log(Object.keys(require('react')).join(', '))"
echo "---"
grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20

grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@types/react/package.json node_modules/@types/react-dom/package.json
echo "---search broader---"
grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/ 2>/dev/null
npm view @types/react@19.2.18 --json 2>&1 | grep -i "canary\|beta\|description" | head -5
grep -n -B2 -A30 "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head -100

cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
echo "---"
cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null
echo "---check @types/react package.json exports---"
grep -n -A20 '"exports"' node_modules/@types/react/package.json | head -40
echo "--- does next set a types override? ---"
find node_modules/next -iname "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -l "react/canary\|/// <reference" 2>/dev/null | head -10
head -20 node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
sed -n '20,35p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -60

nohup npx next dev -p 3311 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 & disown
sleep 3
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3311/
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3311/product/classic-sneakers
which chromium-cli 2>&1; chromium-cli --help 2>&1 | head -20

npx --yes playwright --version 2>&1 | tail -5
ls /workspace/node_modules | grep -i playwright
node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1
node -e "require.resolve('puppeteer')" 2>&1

npm view chromium-cli 2>&1 | head -5
echo "---"
npx playwright install --help 2>&1 | head -5
echo "---check cache for playwright browsers---"
find / -maxdepth 6 -iname "*chromium*" -path "*ms-playwright*" 2>/dev/null | head -5
find ~ -maxdepth 6 -iname "*playwright*" 2>/dev/null | head -10
npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -40
sudo -n npx playwright install-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -40 || npx playwright install-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -40

which apk dnf yum apt 2>&1
cat /etc/os-release 2>&1 | head -5
ldd /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1234/chrome-linux/chrome 2>&1 | grep "not found"
sudo dnf install -y nspr nss atk cups-libs libdrm libXcomposite libXdamage libXfixes libXrandr mesa-libgbm pango alsa-lib at-spi2-atk at-spi2-core 2>&1 | tail -40
node /tmp/vt-test/test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -60

ldd /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1234/chrome-headless-shell-linux64/chrome-headless-shell 2>&1 | grep "not found"
echo "---chrome-linux---"
ldd /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1234/chrome-linux/chrome 2>&1 | grep "not found"

sed -i "s|chromium.launch({ args: \['--no-sandbox'\] })|chromium.launch({ args: ['--no-sandbox'], executablePath: '/home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1234/chrome-linux/chrome' })|" /tmp/vt-test/test.mjs
node /tmp/vt-test/test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -60
find /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1234 -maxdepth 3 -iname "chrome*"

sed -i "s|chrome-linux/chrome'|chrome-linux64/chrome'|" /tmp/vt-test/test.mjs
node /tmp/vt-test/test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -60
sudo dnf install -y libxkbcommon 2>&1 | tail -15
node /tmp/vt-test/test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -80
ls -la /tmp/vt-test/*.png
grep -rn "transitionTypes\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/links.js 2>/dev/null | head -40

grep -n "dispatchNavigateAction" -r /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-instance.js 2>/dev/null | head -5
grep -rn "addTransitionType\|transitionTypes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-instance.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/router-reducer/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -40

lsof -ti:3311 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill
rm -rf /tmp/vt-test
echo done

pgrep -af "next dev" 2>/dev/null
fuser -k 3311/tcp 2>&1 || true
sleep 1
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 2 http://localhost:3311/ 2>&1 || echo "server down"

kill 1315 1328 2>&1
sleep 1
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 2 http://localhost:3311/ 2>&1 || echo "server down"
git status --short && echo "---" && git diff --stat

ls -la /workspace/AGENTS.md /workspace/CLAUDE.md 2>&1
echo "---"
cat /workspace/AGENTS.md 2>&1 | head -5
echo "---"
cat /workspace/CLAUDE.md 2>&1 | head -5
echo "---tsconfig diff---"
git diff tsconfig.json
cat /workspace/.gitignore

rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo /workspace/next-env.d.ts /workspace/AGENTS.md /workspace/CLAUDE.md
git status --short
